what_happened: The job "Trim verifier and study producer prompts to free 100+ tokens each" (prompts) was rejected. The producer cut text from the verifier prompt, including the snapshot wording. A test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs (line 531) enforces that wording, so the athena-context lib test failed (shard 3 of 6, 1 of 11 units). The verifier marked 2 of 7 acceptance criteria unmet: (1) cargo test and clippy pass with no test file modified, and (2) the diff touches only the allowed files and no rule is reworded in meaning (removed text must be repetition or back no rule). It gave 3 blocker or major findings: the snapshot removal breaks the existing test (blocker); D166 says the removed text was repetition or rule-less and that no test was affected, which is false (major); and behavior criterion 2 lacks evidence citing commands that ran, as D43 requires (major). The failed test check is a check, not a criterion. This time the kept output shows part of the passing run and the shard summary naming athena-context --lib, so the failing unit is visible, though not the test name.
cause: Prompt edits are checked against the tests and docs that pin prompt content only at the final verdict. The request told the producer to trim "repetition", but nothing listed which prompt text is enforced by tests (such as the lib.rs snapshot test) or by facts and decision records. The producer judged by reading and could not tell repetition from pinned wording. The decision entry (D166) was written with a claim that no test was affected, and that claim was never run against the suite. Evidence for the behavior criterion was also not tied to commands that ran.
prevention: Add a check that runs before the verifier on any job whose diff touches prompt files. It runs the prompt, brief and budget tests (the athena-context lib tests and the budgets tests) and reports the failing test name and assertion. It also fails if a decision or changelog entry says "no test affected" while those tests fail. Separately, produce the list of prompt phrases that tests pin, and show it to the producer for trimming jobs, so removal targets are chosen from unpinned text. The producer must run these tests after each cut and cite the commands in its evidence.
proposed_request: Trim the verifier and study producer prompts (crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md and the study producer prompt under crates/athena-cap-study/prompts) so each frees at least 100 tokens. Before cutting, list which phrases in each prompt are asserted by tests (for example the snapshot wording checked at crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs:531) and keep those phrases verbatim; remove only repetition of brief content that no test or rule depends on. Do not modify any test file. After each cut run `cargo test --locked -p athena-context --lib` and the budgets tests, and at the end run `cargo test --locked` for the workspace and `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets`; cite these commands and their results in the evidence for each criterion. Touch only prompt .md files under crates/athena-context/prompts, crates/athena-cap-change/prompts and crates/athena-cap-study/prompts, plus docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md and docs/system-facts.md. In the decisions entry, state only what you verified by running the tests, and update docs/system-facts.md for the new token counts. Acceptance: (1) each of the two prompts is at least 100 tokens shorter; (2) the full workspace tests and clippy pass with no test file changed; (3) the diff touches only the allowed files; (4) no rule or brief test is reworded in meaning.
